description: List option contracts. List option contracts from the SIP data feed for US equities (stocks and ETFs) and supported indices only. Filter by strike, range, expiration, or type, and use next_token for further pages. Returned contract codes can be used with /v3/symbols/quotes and, where available, /v3/symbols/{symbol}/series. → Returns {underlying_code: string, last_update: number, last_price?: number, next_token?: string, data: [{code: string, description: string, expiration: string, type: string, status: string, style: string, strike_price: string, multiplier: string, size: string, open_interest?: string|null, open_interest_date?: string|null, close_price?: string|null, close_price_date?: string|null}]}. Search for the underlying with search_symbols. Expiration is YYYY-MM-DD; numeric contract metadata is returned as strings. Strike overrides range; from/to override expiration. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000. Follow next_token with the same filters. Use returned OPRA: codes with get_quotes (up to 10 codes) for price/volume or get_symbol_series for historical bars; use get_options_snapshot for market snapshots and get_options_quotes for chains and Greeks. Guide: https://insightsentry.com/docs/options.

code.description: (Required) Symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Use search_symbols to find the correct code.

expiration.description: (Optional) Exact expiration date. Validated but not used when from or to is provided. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: (Optional) Minimum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

next_token.description: (Optional) Pagination token from a previous /v3/options/contracts response. Send the same filters plus next_token to request the next page.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

range.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. For example, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of the current price. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

strike.description: (Optional) Exact strike price. Takes precedence over range when both are provided.

to.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

name: get_options_contracts
